title: Genuine Darwin/XNU Kernel Boot: From Mach-O Application Execution to Kernel Entry, Early Boot and Operating-System Initialization

level_1_arm64_boot_services.description: ISA execution, EL1/EL2 privilege mode, timer interrupt injection, GICv3 distributor/redistributor, 16KB granule MMU, VBAR vector table

level_2_genuine_kernel_entry.description: Mach-O kernel image parsing, physical segment mapping, Apple DeviceTree and BootArgs Rev 2 handoff, EL1h entry at kernel entry PC

level_3_early_xnu_init.description: Executed early start.s prologue (DAIF masking, boot_args pointer preservation, MPIDR CPU identification, physical base/memSize/DeviceTree retrieval, early UART diagnostics) up to proprietary hardware boundary

level_4_darwin_kernel_services.description: Requires proprietary Apple Interrupt Controller (AICv2), PMGR power manager, and Apple system registers not in public ARM64 specifications

level_5_full_ios_boot.description: Requires proprietary SecureROM, Secure Enclave Processor (SEP), FairPlay encryption keys, and closed Apple hardware co-processors

kernel_image_parser.validation: Full header, command bounds, and W^X segment verification
